officialObservedSemantics: same page exposes HTML/print and CSV download

existingMachineEvidence.existingGap: no authoritative totalCount/range-completeness field is currently preserved for TWSE JSON; existing code therefore correctly keeps absenceCertifiesNoSuspension=false

candidateCompletenessProof.rule: Use the exact replay-window start/end and identical security/category scope across two official representations. Do not guess the CSV endpoint; discover/capture the actual request generated by the official page or another verified TWSE contract.
requiredParity: both responses accepted by source-specific schema/status guards
normalized row-set identity or a strictly explained deterministic representation equivalence
raw body hash for both representations
field-contract identity sufficient to map symbol/suspend/resume rows
repeatability on a positive interval containing known suspension rows before using the contract to certify an empty witness result

falsificationFirst: First validate parity on a bounded interval known to contain positive TWTAWU rows; if JSON and CSV do not reconcile, negative certification is prohibited.
Only after positive parity passes may the same frozen contract be used on the witness exact replay interval.
Empty JSON + empty CSV is not enough if either response lacks proven range/query identity or can be truncated/paginated.
witnessRule: Use one exact-session-ready TWSE witness such as 1101 only as a candidate.
Derive query interval from the actual selected replay window, not a generic annual range.
If no overlapping suspension rows are found under a parity-certified complete bounded query, classify NO_SUSPENSION_IN_COMPLETE_BOUNDED_WINDOW.
Bind both official response hashes and the parity receipt digest into sourceEvidenceRefs/corporate-action completeness evidence.
nonRequirements: TPEx parity for the first TWSE witness
finalPromotionBoundary: NO_SUSPENSION_IN_COMPLETE_BOUNDED_WINDOW may contribute TWSE suspensionCoverage COMPLETE only after physical parity proof; until then CONTINUITY_UNKNOWN remains mandatory.
